name: plain currently on OPT
label: Are you currently on OPT?
spec_quote: Rule `on_opt` answers **No** to questions that ask whether the candidate is currently on OPT: the label has "currently" or "now" and, within the next 60 characters, "OPT" (as a word) or "optional practical training"; or the label says "on OPT" / "on STEM OPT" (any case).

name: Goldman full wording: legally authorized to work with e.g. OPT
label: Are you legally authorized to work in the United States? In other words, do you currently hold or can you obtain valid US work authorization (e.g., currently hold H-1B status, or can commence employment based on F-1 Optional Practical Training (OPT))?
spec_quote: Exception (added 2026-11-05): `on_opt` does NOT take a label that asks about work authorization in general and names OPT only as one example — any label containing "legally authorized to work" ... or "can obtain" / "can you obtain" / "can commence", or "e.g." followed (within 80 characters, before any ")") by "OPT". Such a label is then answered by no rule here (expected answer "none": the runner stops for the candidate).
